core: Dietary lipid absorption and plasma lipoprotein turnover
qualifier: with vitamin E and plant sterol transport
name: Lipoprotein turnover with dietary lipid, vitamin E, phytosterol absorption
rationale: Members cover intestinal lipid digestion/absorption and chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance; vitamin E transport/metabolism and ABCG5/ABCG8 sitosterolemia set it apart from the otherwise nested lipoprotein themes, and it lacks their HDL assembly, LXR and cholesterol-efflux content.

core: E2F G1/S transcription and pre-replicative complex activation
qualifier: with replication stress checkpoint
name: E2F G1/S transcription, pre-replicative complex activation, replication stress checkpoint
rationale: All members are E2F-driven G1/S transcription, ORC/CDC6 pre-RC activation and mitotic DNA replication with ATR replication-stress checkpoint; unlike the larger E2F theme it lacks ORC assembly, DNA unwinding, E2F6 repression and G2/M cell-cycle modules.

core: E2F-driven cell-cycle program
qualifier: with origin assembly, unwinding and G2/M progression
name: E2F cell-cycle program with origin assembly, unwinding, G2/M progression
rationale: Members span E2F target transcription, replication origin licensing and checkpoint, plus ORC assembly, DNA unwinding, E2F6 regulation, G1/S and G2/M transition and cell-cycle/cell-division modules that the smaller E2F licensing theme lacks.

core: Endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular wound healing
qualifier: endothelium-restricted
name: Endothelium-restricted activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular wound healing
rationale: All members concern endothelial activation, leukocyte-endothelial adhesion/extravasation, sprouting, vascular remodeling and wound healing; unlike its superset it has no macrophage, synoviocyte or MMP-secretion members, and unlike other confusables no smooth-muscle migration or VEGF/FGF members.

core: Endothelial activation and vascular remodeling
qualifier: with macrophage survival, synoviocyte proliferation and MMP restraint
name: Endothelial activation with macrophage survival, synoviocyte proliferation, MMP restraint
rationale: Members share the endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular wound-healing core, and add macrophage anti-apoptosis, synoviocyte proliferation and negative regulation of MMP secretion that distinguish it from the endothelium-only theme.

core: Keratinocyte cornification and ectodermal appendage morphogenesis
qualifier: hair, nail, tooth and gland
name: Keratinocyte cornification and hair, nail, tooth, gland morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover cornified envelope formation, keratinocyte differentiation and skin barrier plus hair follicle, nail, tooth (odontoblast, cementum), mammary/sebaceous gland and placode development; tooth odontogenesis separates it from the melanocyte/gut confusables, and it lacks the NF-kB ectodermal dysplasia and junction members of its superset.

core: Epidermal cornification and ectodermal appendage development
qualifier: with NF-kB-dependent ectodermal dysplasia and tooth eruption
name: Epidermal cornification and appendage development with NF-kB ectodermal dysplasia
rationale: Members share keratinocyte cornification and hair, nail, tooth and gland development, and additionally include IKBKG/IkBA anhidrotic ectodermal dysplasia (EDA-ID), dentinogenesis/tooth eruption and epithelial junction modules absent from its subset theme.

core: Epithelial-mesenchymal proliferation control in branching morphogenesis
qualifier: lung and salivary bud
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal proliferation control in lung and salivary bud branching
rationale: All members concern reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling and proliferation in lung and salivary gland bud branching (plus limb bud formation); unlike its superset it lacks trachea and lung vasculature, and unlike other lung themes it lacks pneumocyte/saccule differentiation.

core: Lung branching morphogenesis via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
qualifier: with trachea formation and lung vasculature
name: Lung, trachea and salivary branching via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
rationale: Members share epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and salivary branching, and add trachea formation and cartilage, lung vasculature and terminal-unit dichotomous subdivision that the smaller branching theme lacks.

core: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant drug resistance
qualifier: to afatinib, neratinib and tesevatinib
name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance to afatinib, neratinib, tesevatinib
rationale: All three members are resistance of ERBB2 kinase-domain mutants to a TKI; the specific drugs (afatinib, neratinib, tesevatinib) distinguish it from the six-drug superset that adds AEE788, osimertinib and sapitinib.

core: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant drug resistance
qualifier: including osimertinib, sapitinib and AEE788
name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance including osimertinib, sapitinib, AEE788
rationale: All six members are resistance of ERBB2 kinase-domain mutants to TKIs; it extends the three-drug theme with osimertinib, sapitinib and AEE788, and lacks the constitutive-signaling ERBB/FGFR mutant members of other confusables.

core: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling
qualifier: estradiol-responsive gene transcription
name: Estradiol-responsive gene transcription and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: Members are estrogen/estradiol responses, estrogen-dependent gene expression (including AP-2 growth-factor targets) and progesterone receptor signaling; the transcriptional members distinguish it from the three-member subset, and it has no androgen members.

core: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling
qualifier: positive regulation of estrogen receptor signaling
name: Positive estrogen receptor regulation and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: The three members are estrogen response, positive regulation of intracellular estrogen receptor signaling and progesterone receptor signaling; it lacks the estrogen-dependent transcription members of its superset and the androgen and mammary members of other confusables.

core: Neutrophil differentiation from myeloid progenitors
qualifier: G-CSF and retinoid receptor network
name: G-CSF and retinoid receptor network in neutrophil differentiation
rationale: All members concern G-CSF signaling and the RA/WNT/CSF receptor and PU.1/RAR granulocyte module driving myeloid progenitor to neutrophil differentiation; it lacks the RUNX1 and granulopoiesis transcription members of its superset and the eosinophil/mast or M-CSF members of others.

core: Neutrophil differentiation from myeloid progenitors
qualifier: transcription-factor control including RUNX1
name: Transcriptional control of granulopoiesis from progenitors, with G-CSF signaling
rationale: Members share G-CSF-driven neutrophil differentiation and add transcriptional regulation of granulopoiesis, RUNX1 regulation of HSC differentiation and leukocyte differentiation that distinguish it from the smaller G-CSF theme.

core: Glycerol metabolism and acylglycerol synthesis
qualifier: with fructose metabolism and aquaporin glycerol/urea transport
name: Glycerol and fructose metabolism, aquaporin transport, acylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members cover glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate and alditol/fructose metabolism, aquaporin glycerol and urea transport and phosphatidic acid, MAG/DAG/TAG synthesis; it lacks the lysophospholipid hydrolysis of its superset and the lipolysis/lipid-droplet members of other confusables.

core: Glycerol metabolism and acylglycerol synthesis
qualifier: with lysophospholipid hydrolysis
name: Glycerol metabolism and acylglycerol synthesis with lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members share glycerol/fructose metabolism, aquaporin glycerol transport and PA/DAG/TAG synthesis, and add glycerophospholipid catabolism with LPC and LPE hydrolysis that the smaller glycerol theme lacks.

core: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone signaling
qualifier: organismal growth regulation
name: Organismal growth regulation by GH, prolactin, leptin, thyroid hormone
rationale: All members are GH/prolactin/leptin cytokine-receptor signaling, thyroid hormone generation, transport and receptor signaling, and regulation of organism growth and IGF signaling; it lacks the amino-acid transport, lifespan and GH-secretion members of its superset and the steroidogenic or IL-6-family members of others.

core: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone signaling
qualifier: with lifespan and large neutral amino-acid transport
name: GH, prolactin, leptin, thyroid signaling with lifespan and amino-acid transport
rationale: Members share the GH/prolactin/leptin and thyroid hormone signaling core, and add leucine/isoleucine/phenylalanine transport, determination of adult lifespan, growth rate and GH secretion that the smaller theme lacks.

core: Spinal cord and hindbrain neuron specification
qualifier: spinal motor neuron and interneuron with brainstem maturation
name: Spinal motor neuron and interneuron specification with brainstem maturation
rationale: All members concern dorsoventral spinal cord patterning, motor neuron and interneuron specification and migration, and hindbrain/pons/brainstem development; unlike its superset it has no cranial nerve or peripheral sensory ganglion members, and unlike other confusables no midbrain or neural plate members.

core: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron development
qualifier: with cranial nerve and sensory ganglion development
name: Brainstem, spinal cord, cranial nerve and sensory ganglion neuron development
rationale: Members share hindbrain/spinal cord neuron specification and patterning, and add trigeminal and facial nerve, branchiomotor axon guidance, dorsal root ganglion and peripheral neuron differentiation and suckling behavior that the smaller theme lacks.

core: HSF1 heat shock response and stress granule dynamics
qualifier: with arsenite, PKR and PML-body stress responses
name: HSF1 heat-shock regulation with arsenite, PKR and PML-body responses
rationale: All members are HSF1 activation/attenuation and heat acclimation together with stress granule assembly/disassembly, arsenite response, PKR signaling and PML bodies; it lacks the protein refolding and mitochondrial UPR members of its superset.

core: Heat shock and stress granule response
qualifier: with chaperone refolding and mitochondrial UPR
name: Heat-shock chaperone refolding, mitochondrial UPR and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members share the HSF1 heat shock and stress granule core and add protein refolding, ER protein folding, mitochondrial unfolded protein response and inclusion-body control that the smaller HSF1 theme lacks.

core: IL-6-family cytokine signaling via STAT3 and ERK
qualifier: IL-6, LIF and CNTF
name: IL-6, LIF and CNTF gp130 signaling to STAT3 and ERK1/2
rationale: All members are IL-6-type cytokine (IL-6, LIF, CNTF) receptor signaling through JAK-STAT3 and ERK1/ERK2 activation; it lacks the IL-11, autocrine/paracrine, STAT-inhibition and lymphocyte cytokine-output members of its superset.

core: IL-6-family cytokine signaling
qualifier: autocrine/paracrine, including IL-11 and STAT feedback inhibition
name: Autocrine/paracrine IL-6-family cytokine signaling including IL-11 and STAT feedback inhibition
rationale: Members share IL-6/LIF/CNTF signaling to STAT3 and ERK and add IL-11 signaling, autocrine/paracrine signaling, negative regulation of STAT phosphorylation and receptor binding, and inflammatory cytokine output modules absent from the smaller IL-6 theme.
